## Submission checklist

**Candidate name:**

### Deliverables
- [ ] Repo created from the `ui-intern-assignment` template
- [ ] Live demo deployed (Vercel, Netlify or GitHub Pages) and linked above
- [ ] `ARTICLE.md` completed (400–600 words) — the only accepted location for the article
- [ ] Submitted via Warble's Jotform within 48 hours of receipt

### Functional requirements
- [ ] Type-ahead search with dropdown suggestions from `src/data/tags.ts`
- [ ] Add a tag with Enter or click
- [ ] Remove a tag with its × button, or Backspace on an empty input
- [ ] Duplicate tags are prevented
- [ ] Keyboard navigation: Up/Down to move, Enter to select
- [ ] Responsive layout with smooth tag wrapping
- [ ] Edge cases: empty states, rapid input, long tag names

### Code quality
- [ ] Core component built from scratch (no MUI, Ant Design or similar full UI libraries)
- [ ] Modular structure; type-safe if using TypeScript
- [ ] Event listeners/timers cleaned up properly
- [ ] Accessible: ARIA roles/attributes, labels, visible focus states

### Bonus
- [ ] Basic tests included

### AI usage
- [ ] I can explain every line of this submission in the follow-up chat
